dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown, do I have to attend every class?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, duː aɪ ˈhæf tu əˈtɛnd ˈɛvri ˈklæs?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, you do. And please come on time.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, juː ˈduː. ənd ˈpliːz ˈkʌm ɑːn ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My friend Ploy is absent today. She's sick.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈplɔɪ ɪz ˈæbsənt təˈdeɪ. ʃiːz ˈsɪk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Does she have to do today's assignment?
dialogue.reading: dʌz ʃiː ˈhæf tə ˈduː təˈdeɪz əˈsaɪnmənt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, she does. But she doesn't have to do it today.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ʃiː ˈdʌz. bʌt ʃiː ˈdʌzənt ˈhæf tə ˈduː ɪt təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then when does she have to do it?
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈwɛn dʌz ʃiː ˈhæf tə ˈduː ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Before next Monday. Can you tell her, please?
dialogue.reading: bɪˈfɔːr ˈnɛkst ˈmʌndeɪ. kən juː ˈtɛl hɜːr, ˈpliːz?
